user.title: Ozon — cookies
user.description:
Export cookies from ozon.ru (Firefox + Cookie-Editor works best).

1. Open https://www.ozon.ru/my/orderlist and wait for the order list
2. Stay on the page for 15–20 seconds
3. Cookie-Editor → Export → JSON (full array)
4. JSON must include abt_data and __Secure-access-token (usually ≥ 12 cookies)

Chrome often exports a trimmed set without abt_data — Ozon then returns antibot 403.

sync.title: Ozon — sync & antibot
sync.description: Recommended defaults reduce Variti blocks. Order status and ETA come from the list; product titles need extra detail requests.

error.invalid_auth: Ozon rejected the session. Re-export cookies from /my/orderlist
error.invalid_json: Invalid JSON — paste the full cookies array
error.missing_antibot_cookies: Missing abt_data — open /my/orderlist, wait 15–20 sec, export from Firefox
error.antibot: Ozon antibot (403). Refresh cookies or increase the poll interval

init.title: Ozon — sync & antibot
init.description: 30 min interval and 1 detail per cycle is a good default. On 403 the integration enters automatic backoff.
